newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta ruling party headed for election win - poll.
newsitem.headline: Alberta ruling party headed for election win - poll.

text.p: Alberta's ruling Conservative party appeared headed for another landslide victory in the province's upcoming general election, according to poll results released on Thursday.

An opinion poll conducted during February by Angus Reid Group for CFCN television and the Calgary Herald newspaper indicated that the Conservatives, led by Premier Ralph Klein, could win as many as 70 of Alberta's 83 seats in the provincial legislature.
Alberta voters go to the polls on March 11.
